facts.business: Bank of India is a public sector bank providing banking and financial services including deposits, advances, investments, and priority sector lending across domestic and international operations.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Priority Sector Lending constituted 46.36% of Adjusted Net Bank Credit against regulatory threshold of 40%
Share of Agricultural Credit to Adjusted Net Bank Credit was 19.56% as on 31.03.2026, against the regulatory requirement of 18%
Capital Adequacy Ratio stood at an improved level of 18.01% as on 31.03.2026 as against 17.77% as on 31.03.2025

key_risks: 17.42% of advances, 29.60% of deposits, 13.96% of interest income and 23.03% of interest expended from unaudited branches
16.52% of Non-performing asset from unaudited branches as at March 31, 2026
